item.summary: Binance co-founder and co-chief executive Yi He said Kaiser Ng is leaving as chief financial officer after more than five years to pursue a new venture, with a transition plan that has been under way for about six months, according to The Block and The Globe and Mail. Justin Yek, previously vice-president of finance at Airwallex, is taking over as CFO. The announcement came days after the late-October theft from Binance; Yi He did not say the departure was caused by the incident.
